entities.name: Gulsen
entities.description: Faithful, authoritative abbey matron of Onella in Aysen on Ulgrotha, who believed in Serra's return.

entities.name: Onella
entities.description: City in Aysen where Gulsen served.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Figure Gulsen believed in; her prolonged absence was actually due to her death, unknown on Ulgrotha.

events.summary: Gulsen worries about the death of abbot Hazduhr should Serra fail to return to elect a new abbot.
events.quote: She did express worry about the results of the death of the abbot Hazduhr should Serra fail to return to elect a new abbot.
